caption: The drawing depicts two views of a two-pronged fork rendered in pencil or similar grayscale medium. The fork is shown from the front on the left and from the side on the right. Both prongs are long and narrow, and the handle is elongated with various decorative elements. The handle's upper section features geometric patterns, including a series of diamond shapes and rectangular bands, while the lower part of the handle is decorated with an ornate floral or vine motif, culminating in a single pointed tip at the end. The side view illustrates the slight curvature of the fork’s body, showing how the handle and prongs are not perfectly straight but slightly angled at the top. The drawing is centered on a cream or lightly yellowed rectangular sheet with a double-lined border, and there is a small handwritten label in the bottom right corner.
title: Fork
